## Carried — the real M365 agent-governance surface is Agent 365 (reported 2026-08-10)
GA since 2026-05-01. Tenant-wide agent registry that DISCOVERS SHADOW AGENTS, a ten-type risk
taxonomy (prompt injection, excessive permissions, sensitive data access, ownerless agents), and
block / unblock / ownership-reassignment actions exposed through a **Microsoft Graph API**.
Foundry Agent Applications are NOT in the Entra agent registry — Microsoft's own documented gap.

Updated: 2026-08-24 — no change on any of the three; Graph RSS regression now 4 scans old.
